stepBody:
To reduce model complexity, the owner computes the optimal θ by minimizing the following regularized loss function:
$$L(\vec{	heta}) $$=$$ $$(||Y$$ $$-$$ X\vec{	heta}||_2)**{2} + $$\lambda$$ g(\vec{	heta})$$
where $$g(\vec{	heta})$$ is a non-constant function of $$\vec{	heta}$$ and $$\lambda$$ $$\geq$$ $$0$$. $$If$$ $$the$$ $$magnitude$$ $$of$$ $$any$$ $$	heta_i$$ increases, $$g(\vec{	heta})$$ will also increase.
Which of the following options reduces model complexity?
choices: Changing λ has no effect on model complexity.
Both increasing and decreasing λ reduce complexity.
The effect depends on the choice of g(θ).
